Mascarpone With Berries
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 12:24am

Ingredients




1 cup Mascarpone cheese
1/2 cup creme fraiche
1/4 cup sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla
2 pints berries

Preparation

1 Combine cheese and creme fraiche in a bowl and mix until blended and smooth. Add sugar and vanilla and whip with an electric mixer for 4-5 minutes until stiff peaks form. Divide fresh, hulled berries among 4-6 cups and top with mascarpone mixture. Serve cold. 2 Serves 4-6. 3 This really is an easy, delicious summertime dessert:
